effect_description_eng:
[On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 [Game] trait card and 1 [Invincible], [Life] or [Entertainment] trait card among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
[Your Turn] When any of your Digimon get linked to a [Game], [Life] or [Entertainment] trait card, by suspending this Tamer, gain 1 memory.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
